title: Messages
intro: Private conversations with the Chickens you are connected to.
empty: No conversations yet. Start one with an acquaintance or a friend.

badge.label: {count, plural, one {# unread message} other {# unread messages}}

name.untitled: {count, plural, one {Group of # Chicken} other {Group of # Chickens}}

invite.explain: You see who is in the group once you join. Declining tells no one.

start.title: New message
start.hint: One Chicken starts a private conversation; several start a group. You can write to your acquaintances and friends.
start.none: You are not connected to anyone yet.
start.sharing: The post goes along as the first message.

conv.beginning: This is the beginning of the conversation.
conv.mutedHint: Muted: no push notifications from this conversation.
conv.leaveConfirm: Leave this group? You will stop seeing its messages.
conv.clearConfirm: Delete this conversation for you? The other Chicken keeps their copy.
conv.cantSend: You can no longer send messages here: you are not connected to this Chicken any more.

composer.label: Message
composer.hint: Enter sends; Shift+Enter starts a new line.
composer.counter: {count, plural, one {# character left} other {# characters left}}

post.unavailable: This post isn't available to you.

share.title: Share post
share.sent: {count, plural, one {Sent to # conversation.} other {Sent to # conversations.}}
share.audience: Only people who can already see this post will see it; everyone else gets a placeholder.
share.failed: {count, plural, one {Could not send to # conversation.} other {Could not send to # conversations.}}

errors.not_connected: You can only write to Chickens you are connected to.
errors.recipient_self: You can't start a conversation with yourself.
errors.too_many_members: A group holds up to 32 Chickens.
errors.title_too_long: The group name is too long.
errors.probation: New accounts can't start groups or invite people yet.
errors.not_admin: Only the group's admin can do that.
